basics.name: Ante Javor
basics.label: Engineer
basics.summary: Engineer at Memgraph working across the stack: database benchmarking and performance, C++ and Rust clients, Kubernetes deployment, and AI agent memory with graph retrieval and evaluation. I like measuring things and keeping what holds up.

work.name: Memgraph
work.summary: Across the stack, from engine benchmarks and clients to AI agents.
highlights: AI: Context Graph, a graph-backed memory for coding agents (capture hooks, MCP memory backend, multi-user spaces, hybrid retrieval, GLiNER2 extraction, LongMemEval and BEAM evaluation); SQL2Graph and HyGM; Unstructured2Graph; LangChain and MCP integrations.
Benchmarking: mgbench C++ client with client-side p50 to p99 latency, mixed and time-dependent workloads, LDBC datasets up to SF10, CI benchmark runs.
Clients and deployment: Helm charts, the Rust client (rsmgclient), mgconsole packaging and releases.
Engine: replication logging, snapshot checks, a GNN import and export module.
Docs, tutorials, and 22 posts on the Memgraph blog.
